newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH JUNE PAPER EXPORTS VIA PORTS +0.2 PCT Y/Y.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH JUNE PAPER EXPORTS VIA PORTS +0.2 PCT Y/Y.

text.p: The rise in Finnish paper exports through ports slowed to 0.2 percent year-on-year in June from 18.7 percent in May and 17.2 percent in April, the Board of Navigation said in a monthly report on Friday.
Paper exports through ports totalled 647,677 tonnes in June, up 1,475 tonnes, the board said.
In January-June, paper exports through ports increased 16.1 percent on the year-ago period to 4.43 million tonnes.
Overall, Finnish exports through ports increased 6.1 percent year-on-year in June to 2.88 million tonnes and 11.1 percent in the first half of 1997 to 18.11 million tonnes, the board said.
Imports through ports increased 22.8 percent year-on-year in June to 3.73 million tonnes and in January-June, imports through ports rose 10.2 percent to 17.95 million tonnes, the board said.
